scope: Official NYC architecture-related project records from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19, checked against data/manual_drops/architecture_milestones/architecture_milestones_2008_2026.json by source URL fragments, record IDs, and project titles.

source_audits.source_name: HPD news and press release pages
source_audits.publisher: New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Project address, site name, neighborhood, or street segment when stated in page text
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYC official web page. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review NYC Terms of Use before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated announcements, openings, completions, ribbon cuttings, financing, and groundbreakings.
source_audits.caveats: Press release dates are announcement dates. Completion, full lease-up, and ribbon-cutting can be different dates and should remain distinct when the page states more than one.
source_audits.recommendation: Use as documented candidate source; verify exact parcel geometry with NYC geocoder or PLUTO before production ingest.

source_audits.source_name: NYC Health + Hospitals press releases and location pages
source_audits.source_type: official public health system press release and facility location page
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Facility name and address on release or official location page
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYC Health + Hospitals official web pages. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review site Terms of Use before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated clinic openings and renovations at named public health facilities.
source_audits.caveats: Some records are clinics or departments inside larger hospitals rather than standalone buildings. Geometry should be treated as facility/campus point unless a room or floor is stated.
source_audits.recommendation: Use as documented candidate source where the product wants health-facility interior renovation/opening milestones.

source_audits.publisher: New York City Economic Development Corporation
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Named project, public space, building address, street segment, or adjacent property stated in page text
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYCEDC official web page. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review NYCEDC terms before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated public-space openings, public-site RFPs, lease-up, and renovation milestones.
source_audits.caveats: EDC pages often combine completed work, RFP releases, expected construction, and policy framing in one announcement. Candidate records should isolate the dated source-stated built milestone only.
source_audits.recommendation: Use for public realm and public-site milestones; avoid importing economic impact language.

source_audits.source_name: NYC Parks press and park news pages
source_audits.publisher: New York City Department of Parks and Recreation
source_audits.source_type: official agency press release, park news, or official mirrored park press page
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City parks and public realm
source_audits.date_fields_observed: Press release date or park news listing date
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Park name, park ID, beach/street segment, and borough
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYC Parks official web page. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review NYC Terms of Use before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated park openings, ribbon cuttings, and completion announcements when the official record is accessible.
source_audits.caveats: Some nycgovparks.org press pages are intermittently blocked; prefer accessible official mirrors at www2.nycgovparks.org or park-specific news pages.
source_audits.recommendation: Use accessible official page URLs only; reject or defer records where only non-official summaries are available.

source_audits.source_name: NYC Department of Cultural Affairs press pages and Materials for the Arts pages
source_audits.publisher: New York City Department of Cultural Affairs
source_audits.source_type: official agency press release and official program page
source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City cultural facilities and programs
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Named facility, borough, warehouse/program location, or official address page
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYC official web page. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review NYC Terms of Use before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated cultural facility ribbon-cuttings and openings.
source_audits.caveats: Some cultural projects are within existing buildings; keep these as renovation or interior facility milestones, not new-building completions.
source_audits.recommendation: Use as documented source for public cultural-space records.

source_audits.geographic_scope: New York City public housing campuses
source_audits.geometry_fields_observed: Development name, borough, and neighborhood when stated in page text
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: NYC official web page. Use factual metadata and attribution only; review NYC Terms of Use before redistributing text, images, or full page content.
source_audits.reliability: High for source-stated completion and ribbon-cutting milestones at public housing facilities.
